# weft_security_group (Resource)

Security group within a project. Mirrors CreateSecurityGroup / RenameSecurityGroup / SetSecurityGroupDescription / SetSecurityGroupRules / DeleteSecurityGroup.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Security group name. Mutable via RenameSecurityGroup.
- `project` (String) Owning project (display name or UUID). Immutable.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Mutable via SetSecurityGroupDescription.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Replace-all rule list. Mutable via SetSecurityGroupRules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of creation.
- `id` (String) Mirrors `uuid`; satisfies the Terraform ID convention.
- `project_uuid` (String) Resolved project UUID.
- `uuid` (String) Server-minted SG UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `direction` (String) "ingress" | "egress".
- `protocol` (String) "tcp" | "udp" | "icmp" | "any".

Optional:

- `port_max` (Number) Inclusive upper port. 0 when N/A.
- `port_min` (Number) Inclusive lower port. 0 when N/A.
- `remote_cidr` (String) CIDR block of the peer. Mutually exclusive with `remote_group_uuid`.
- `remote_group_uuid` (String) UUID of a peer security group. Mutually exclusive with `remote_cidr`.
